title: Shared article link goes to "Resource Not Found"
what_happened: My colleague's link opened to a page that just says "Resource Not Found". No title, no hint what it was or where it moved.
expected: The article my colleague sent, or at least a redirect to where it moved now.

title: Resources page says no articles exist, even though a colleague shared one
what_happened: The Resources page says "No articles published yet. Check back soon." My colleague sent me an article from this site, so it either existed once or the link was never right. Either way there is nothing for me to read.
expected: The article my colleague sent, and a list of other pieces by the same people.

title: Contact form doesn't say what happens to my email, and there is no plain email or phone
what_happened: The "Let's Connect" form is short and the phone number is optional, which is good. But it only says "We'll get back to you soon." Nothing says whether I'd be put on a mailing list, and I can't see a plain email address or phone number for a low-key first contact.
expected: A line saying who will reply and that I won't be added to marketing emails, or a direct email address I could use myself.
